name: anchor
description: Local proxy that caches AI API calls and tracks spend. Free, OSS, no telemetry.

scripts.build:all: bun build src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=dist/anchor-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile=dist/anchor-darwin-x64 && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=dist/anchor-linux-x64 && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=dist/anchor-linux-arm64
